labels.ambient: Background sound. Unwanted in Quiet and Balanced; Sensitive mentions it once at low priority by design.
labels.duplicate: A repeat of something already reported.
labels.important: Should lead to an alert in every mode (warning signal, knock, possible spoken warning, new independent occurrence).
labels.irrelevant: Must never alert (music, probable lyrics, handling noise, muted categories).
labels.optional: Depends on mode and context (dog, ordinary or informative speech). Neither required nor an error.

note: Scripted synthetic input replayed through the production AttentionEngine. Not real-world accuracy.
